audit_title: STEP 54D-VALIDATION — HISTORICAL RISK DENSITY THRESHOLD AUDIT
audit_type: READ-ONLY AUDIT — NO SOURCE CODE OR DATA MODIFIED.

provenance_and_regional_distribution.primary_source: NASA Global Landslide Catalog (GLC) (Disaster Charter, July 9, 2023 Northern India event)

northeast_region_coverage_in_current_db.notes: All 176 historical records in MongoDB originate from the July 2023 disaster event. No Northeast India records are in the current database collection.

A_almost_everything_becomes_high.detail: 65.3% (115 of 176 records) are classified as HIGH. The threshold of 80 is below the empirical median of 88.

B_almost_everything_becomes_medium.detail: 30.7% (54 of 176 records) are classified as MEDIUM.

C_almost_everything_becomes_low.detail: LOW is virtually empty: exactly 1 single record (0.57%) falls in the 3-19 interval.

D_almost_everything_becomes_insufficient.detail: Only 3.4% (6 of 176 records) fall into INSUFFICIENT.

E_useful_geographic_differentiation.detail: The map displays an almost solid red core with a yellow fringe, almost zero green (1 point), and no intermediate density resolution.

F_excessive_overlap_from_10km_radius.detail: In a compact 59 km x 44 km disaster inventory, a 10 km radius circle covers ~20% of the entire area, aggregating up to 124 neighboring points.

G_thresholds_unsupported_by_actual_datas.detail: Thresholds were conceived a priori without empirical reference to the cluster distribution. The LOW band [3, 19] fails entirely because once points leave the perimeter (<3), they immediately jump to 20+ neighbors.

H_deterministic_and_reproducible.detail: The Haversine calculation and preclassifyHistoricalEvents function are 100% deterministic and mathematically reproducible.

scientific_and_semantic_check.early_warning_pipeline_isolation: Verified that historical events are filtered to Historical mode only and never dispatched to the early-warning decision engine.

map_usefulness_assessment.for_northeast_india: Low utility currently because zero historical records exist in the database for the Northeast Region (Assam, Meghalaya, Sikkim, etc.). Any NER query correctly indicates 'Insufficient Historical Evidence'.
map_usefulness_assessment.for_mapped_cluster: Moderate utility for identifying the overall epicenter, but poor gradient utility due to threshold skew: 65% of all markers render red and only 1 marker renders green.

rationale: The current threshold set (80 / 20 / 3) creates a statistically degenerate distribution: 65.3% HIGH, 30.7% MEDIUM, 0.6% LOW (1 point), and 3.4% INSUFFICIENT. The LOW category is practically non-existent. A defensible classification must provide a balanced gradient across the empirical density spectrum.

alternative_1_quantile_based.description: Based on empirical quantiles (p75 for High, p35 for Medium, p10 for Low)

alternative_2_balanced_density.description: Round numbers providing balanced four-tier distribution

alternative_3_radius_refinement.description: Refine radius to 5 km to capture localized micro-catchment corridors

audit_conclusion: READ-ONLY AUDIT COMPLETE. No source code, models, thresholds, or datasets were modified.
